verdicts.title: The Bell states in noncommutative algebraic geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
We introduce new mathematical aspects of the Bell states using matrix factorizations, nonnoetherian singularities, and noncommutative blowups. A matrix factorization of a polynomial $p$ consists of two matrices $φ_1,φ_2$ such that $φ_1φ_2 = φ_2φ_1 = p \operatorname{id}$.
